_comment: Shared output-interpretation contract for the two grading runners. The INPUT fields (stdout/stderr/exitCode) are fed to RunnerCore's interpretScriptOutput, which BOTH runners now use (the worker directly; the browser via the wasm executeSuites bridge). `native` records the exact display strings + partial-credit `score` interpretScriptOutput produces and is the single source of truth — Tests/WorkerTests/OutputContractTests.swift asserts the native build matches it, and Tests/BrowserRunnerJSTests/output-contract.test.mjs drives the REAL vendored wasm and asserts it matches too, so the two runners are byte-identical (status, shortResult, longResult, score). interpretScriptOutput strips a leading `<test>: ` label from shortResult (when the footer carries a `test` field) and surfaces a footer `traceback` field as longResult. `score` is the fraction of the test's points earned, in 0...1: an explicit footer `score` wins (clamped, orthogonal to the exit-code status), else 1 on a pass and 0 otherwise. NOTE: the wasm side only asserts `score` once the vendored artifact carries it (re-vendored on main by runner-wasm-vendor.yml); the native side always asserts it.

cases.name: fail with human message then JSON footer
error with footer traceback field (surfaced as longResult)

{"shortResult":"Q1: Could not test calculate_bmi","status":"error","test":"Q1","error":"Could not test calculate_bmi","traceback":"Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"t.py\", line 3\nNotImplementedError"}

cases.name: exit code 3 maps to fail (Marmoset convention), stderr only
partial-credit score on a failing exit code (score is orthogonal to status)
out-of-range footer score is clamped to 0...1
JSON footer followed by trailing blank lines (last-non-empty-line robustness)
pass with human stdout then JSON footer (footer stripped on the pass path)
timeout wins over exit code (SIGKILL after the limit, empty output)
timeout with partial stderr surfaced (exit -1 SIGKILL)
